# v1.5.1 — Catalog agent rows named by the task they perform

> **zread-pi 1.5.1**: the per-agent rows in the generate view are now named by what each agent
> is actually doing — `Planning themes` → `Drafting titles · <section>` → `Refining titles · <section>`
> — instead of the bare stage nouns. The catalog's stage-progress text uses the same wording.

## 🔧 What changed

| Before | After | What the agent does |
|---|---|---|
| `Classify` | `Planning themes` | reads the repo and lays out the wiki's themes (sections) |
| `Topics · <section>` | `Drafting titles · <section>` | drafts the article titles for one theme |
| `Titles · <section>` | `Refining titles · <section>` | refines the drafted titles |
| `Condense · <section>` | `Trimming themes` / `Trimming titles · <section>` | condenses an out-of-range list (named after the stage it runs in) |

- The stage-progress text on the catalog aggregate row now uses the same words
  (`Planning themes` → `Drafting titles {current}/{total}` → `Refining titles {current}/{total}`),
  so one stage is never called two different things on screen.
- Internal names are untouched: `CatalogEvent.stage` (`classify` / `topics` / `titles`),
  `agentKey`, and the wiki.json `sections` field keep their names — this is purely i18n wording.
- Both `zh-CN` and `en-US` dictionaries were updated together.

## 📦 Install

```bash
# Option 1: standalone binary (zip attached to this release, unzip and run)
#   zread-pi-v1.5.1-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# Option 2: from source
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <target-repo>
```

## ✅ Verification

- `bun run typecheck`: 0 errors
- `bun run test`: all suites pass (EXIT=0) — including `mock-generate` 46/46 with the new
  wording assertions (`Planning themes` progress + `Drafting titles ·` / `Refining titles ·` rows)

# v1.5.1 —— 目录 Agent 行改按任务命名

> **zread-pi 1.5.1**：生成页的逐 Agent 行不再用阶段名词，而是按每个 Agent 实际在做的事命名：
> `规划主题` → `拟定标题 · <主题>` → `精修标题 · <主题>`；目录聚合行的阶段进度与行名同词。

## 🔧 改动内容

| 之前 | 之后 | 该 Agent 在做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `分类` | `规划主题` | 分析仓库，产出主题（章节）清单 |
| `主题 · <主题>` | `拟定标题 · <主题>` | 为一个主题拟定文章标题 |
| `标题 · <主题>` | `精修标题 · <主题>` | 精修已拟定好的标题 |
| `缩编 · <主题>` | `精简主题` / `精简标题 · <主题>` | 数量越界时归并精简清单（按所在阶段选词） |

- 聚合行的阶段进度文案同步改为 `规划主题中` → `拟定标题 {current}/{total}` → `精修标题 {current}/{total}`，
  同一阶段在屏幕上不再有两种叫法。
- 内部名称一律不变：`CatalogEvent.stage`（`classify` / `topics` / `titles`）、`agentKey`、
  wiki.json 的 `sections` 字段——只改 i18n 字符串。
- `zh-CN` / `en-US` 两份词典同步更新。

## 📦 安装

```bash
# 方式一：standalone 二进制（本 Release 附带的 zip，解压即用）
#   zread-pi-v1.5.1-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# 方式二：从源码运行
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <目标仓库>
```

## ✅ 验证

- `bun run typecheck`：0 错误
- `bun run test`：全部套件通过（EXIT=0）——含 `mock-generate` 46/46 的新文案断言
  （`规划主题中` 进度 + `拟定标题 ·` / `精修标题 ·` 行）
